title: Deadlock, Livelock & Starvation

description: The four Coffman conditions, lock ordering, tryLock, detection with thread dumps, and livelock vs starvation in LLD designs.

hero.html:
Level 4 - Advanced 50 min Concurrency Asked at Cleartrip

Deadlock, Livelock & Starvation

Why two threads can wait for each other forever, the four conditions that must all be true for that to happen, and the three fixes interviewers expect: one global lock order, tryLock with back-off, and never calling unknown code while holding a lock. Plus how to read a thread dump, and why you already know this from lockdep.
